bbox.title: Bounding box (west,south,east,north)
bbox.description: Area to search, in decimal degrees: west,south,east,north (min longitude, min latitude, max longitude, max latitude). Copy it from bboxfinder.com or any map tool. Up to 10 square degrees per run; split larger regions into several runs.

centerLat.title: Or: center latitude
centerLat.description: Alternative to bbox: latitude of the center point, e.g. 30.27. Used only when bbox is empty.

centerLon.title: Or: center longitude
centerLon.description: Alternative to bbox: longitude of the center point, e.g. -97.74. Used only when bbox is empty.

radiusKm.title: Radius around the center (km)
radiusKm.description: Half-width of the square around the center point, 0.05 to 150 km. Default 2.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Overture category names, matched against the primary category, its parents and alternates. Examples: restaurant, cafe, dentist, plumber, hair_salon, real_estate_agent, lawyer, gym, hotel, car_dealer, bar, bakery. Lower case with underscores; leave empty for all businesses.

websiteFilter.title: Website filter
websiteFilter.description: Pick 'without a website' for web-design and local-SEO prospecting.

requirePhone.title: Only businesses with a phone number
requirePhone.description: Drop places without a phone number. Combine with 'without a website' for call lists.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence (0 to 1)
minConfidence.description: Overture's existence confidence score. 0.5 keeps most real businesses; 0.8 keeps only well-corroborated ones. Default 0 (no filter).

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (US, GB, DE ...). Useful when the bbox crosses a border.

excludeClosed.title: Exclude permanently closed places
excludeClosed.description: Skip places Overture marks as permanently closed. Temporarily closed places are kept.

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the business name.

maxResults.title: Maximum leads
maxResults.description: Stop after this many leads (highest confidence first). The run cost is bounded by this number.

release.title: Overture release
release.description: Overture Maps release to read (monthly). See docs.overturemaps.org/release for the list.

threads.title: DuckDB threads
threads.description: Parallelism for reading parquet row groups. 4 is right for a 1 GB run.

memoryLimit.title: DuckDB memory limit
memoryLimit.description: Keep below the run's memory. Raise together with the run memory for very large areas.
